description: Consumer complaint under Section 35 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 before District Commission

fields.label: Deficiency in Service / Defect in Goods (detailed narrative)
fields.placeholder: Describe what you purchased/availed, when, the defect/deficiency, attempts to resolve, dates of correspondence...

sections.template: CONSUMER COMPLAINT UNDER SECTION 35 OF THE CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT, 2019

TO,
THE HONOURABLE PRESIDENT AND MEMBERS,
DISTRICT CONSUMER DISPUTES REDRESSAL COMMISSION,
{court_city}

MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH:

sections.prompt_context:
Generate 8-12 numbered paragraphs for a Consumer Complaint under Section 35 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. Structure:
Para 1: Introduce the complainant — {applicant_name}, S/o {father_name}, aged {applicant_age} years, R/o {address} — as a 'consumer' within the meaning of Section 2(7) CPA 2019. Use these EXACT identity details as provided; do NOT invent or substitute any party name, parentage, age, or address.
Para 2: Identify the Opposite Party and their business.
Para 3-6: Narrate the facts chronologically — purchase/service, defect/deficiency, attempts to resolve: {deficiency_details}. Mention Invoice No. {invoice_number}, dated {purchase_date}, amount Rs. {consideration_amount}/- paid via {payment_mode}.
Para 7: Establish that the Opposite Party's conduct amounts to 'deficiency in service' (Section 2(11)) and/or 'defect' (Section 2(10)) and constitutes an 'unfair trade practice' (Section 2(47)).
Para 8: Territorial jurisdiction: {territorial_basis}
Para 9: Pecuniary jurisdiction: {pecuniary_basis}. NOTE: Per CPA (Jurisdiction) Notification dated 21 December 2021, District Commission has jurisdiction where value of goods/services paid as consideration does NOT EXCEED Rs. 50 Lakh. State Commission: above Rs. 50 Lakh up to Rs. 2 Crore. National Commission: above Rs. 2 Crore. Do NOT use the old Section 34(1) limits (Rs. 1 Crore) — those were superseded by this notification.
Para 10: Limitation: {limitation_basis}
Para 11: State that the complainant is entitled to refund, compensation for mental agony and harassment (Rs. {compensation_claimed}/-), and litigation costs (Rs. {litigation_cost}/-).
Do NOT generate the prayer or verification — those are template-handled.

sections.template:
VERIFICATION

I, {applicant_name}, the Complainant herein above named, do hereby verify that the contents of paragraphs 1 to {body_para_count} of the above complaint are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief, and nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {court_city} on this _____ day of _________, {current_year}.


_________________________
{applicant_name}
(Complainant)
AI-assisted draft — verify with applicable law before filing. Lawie does not provide legal advice.

related_acts: Consumer Protection Act 2019 — Sections 2, 34, 35, 38, 39, 69 (Pecuniary per 21 Dec 2021 Notification: District Commission up to Rs.50 Lakh, State Commission Rs.50L-2Cr, National Commission above Rs.2Cr)
filing_checklist: Original + 2 copies of the complaint (total 3 sets)
Affidavit in support of complaint (format per local rules)
Copy of invoice / receipt / bill (Invoice No. {invoice_number})
Copy of all correspondence with Opposite Party (emails, letters)
Copy of product/service warranty card (if applicable)
Photographs / videos of defective product (if applicable)
Court fee (as per state Consumer Commission rules — typically Rs. 100-500)
Proof of payment (bank statement / credit card statement)
